{{Quote|Are you stupid or just ignorant? No questionable transactions until that array's done! They're keeping too close an eye.|Shifala merchant to [[Ania Solo]]|<ref name="Legacy 1" />}}
This '''Unidentified Shifala''' owned a store on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carreras Major]]. In [[138 ABY]], [[Ania Solo]] and her friend [[Sauk]] tried to sell an [[Imperial Knight]] [[Imperial Knight lightsaber|lightsaber]] to the merchant. Afraid of being caught due to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Biala]]'s tightening of security on the planet, the merchant refused to buy the lightsaber and threw Ania and Sauk out of the store.<ref name="Legacy 1" />
